summary: This tutorial-style video demonstrates how warped brake rotors manifest during driving and braking. It demonstrates common symptoms—lurching in the seat, left-right wheel vibration, a pulsating brake pedal distinct from ABS activation—and uses a highway test and an off-ramp braking sequence on a 2005 Cadillac CTS to illustrate the phenomena. The presenters conclude that the observed symptoms indicate a need for front brake pad and rotor replacement to restore smooth, safe stopping, and they promote 1A Auto parts as a source for replacement components.
title: Diagnosing Warped Rotors on a 2005 Cadillac CTS: On-Road Symptoms and Replacement Recommendation
